ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across ~85% of surface; low-intensity (black/dark) concentrated at the trailing edge, median notch, and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white macro-blob covering primary lobe surfaces; irregular dark pigmentation borders the entire trailing edge; a dense vertical dark cluster is centered at the median notch; isolated dark circular spots on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated pixel angle of 52 degrees and deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the entire trailing boundary; high-amplitude variations (5-15 pixels) concentrated at the distal tips, creating a jagged, irregular topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall concave curve originating from the central base, terminating in a slight upward convexity at the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast dark pixel clusters at both the left and right distal tips; scattered small circular dark spots visible on the left inner lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, dark diagonal linear mark on the right lobe; multiple faint, nearly vertical linear disruptions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular protrusion and dark scarring at both distal tips; yellowish-brown chromatic staining on the lower-center ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized orange-brown pixel discoloration in the lower-central region of the left lobe.
